name: Mo Shuming
current_role: Co-founder (and long-time vice chairman) of Guangdong Mingcrown Group, Dongguan
profile: Dongguan-born entrepreneur who co-founded Guangdong Mingcrown Group (名冠集团) in 1994 with Mo Zhiming. The family conglomerate spans construction, real estate, steel/new materials (Huaguan), Xinhui Port logistics, hotels, schools and a golf club; it is now chaired by Mo Guanliang and ranks among Guangdong's top 500 companies.
interesting_fact: Mingcrown is pivoting into culture-tourism: in March 2026 it won Dongguan's first land auction of the year for RMB 730m to build the Mingcrown Oasis theme-park project, and signed a strategic deal with Tencent Cloud in April 2026.
notes: Very low public profile; the group site names him only as co-founder. A 2012 Xinhui district government page called him vice chairman of Mingcrown. Day-to-day leadership is now Mo Guanliang (chairman) and Mo Guanjing (president). Hurun listed him jointly with Yao Hesong. Best route is the group's corporate email.
